# llm-note (v1.0.5)

llm-note is a local-first notes and notebook application that an LLM assistant or coding agent can use for its user. It stores structured notes in local SQLite and supports human-editable plain-text notebook files. It provides a Python command-line interface, an optional loopback web interface at `127.0.0.1`, and an agent skill definition.

Version: 1.0.5
Last-checked: 2026-10-12
License: MIT (see LICENSE)
Runtime packages: No additional Python runtime packages are declared in pyproject.toml.

- MediaBrain: Personal video and music library with smart playlists and streaming history (https://github.com/doc-bricks/MediaBrain)
- MailProcessor: Windows tray app for launching the local Universal Mail tools (https://github.com/doc-bricks/MailProcessor)
- ProSync: Cross-platform directory synchronization (https://github.com/file-bricks/ProSync)
- CloudLockFixer: Delayed file operations in cloud-sync folders with SHA-256-verified copy/delete fallbacks (https://github.com/file-bricks/CloudLockFixer)
- open-bricks organization profile / umbrella catalog (not a specific repository): https://github.com/open-bricks

Consumer reference (FolderHome manifest at source commit `51d5dc7`): pins this repository at `b5fe59fc155ded9603566aa0fb920a53181a2426` and declares `notes.read` plus gated `notes.write` (`default_mode = dry-run`, `live_enabled = false`). [Manifest](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/FolderHome/blob/51d5dc71ec11f1cde4598c528323483a50f6e52c/manifests/components/llm-note.toml); [provider checkout guide](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/FolderHome/blob/51d5dc71ec11f1cde4598c528323483a50f6e52c/docs/provider-checkouts.md).
BACH provenance reference: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/bach (related source reference; no current consumer integration is claimed)

Audience & use:
- Agent and application developers who need local SQLite notes and plain-text notebooks.
- Developers who prefer local storage and a loopback interface without requiring a hosted note service.
- Researchers who want human-readable notebook files alongside structured SQLite records.

Capabilities:
- Local SQLite note storage and plain-text notebook files.
- Command-line operations for writing, reading, searching, and managing notes.
- Optional web interface bound to loopback.
- Six bundled message locales: English, German, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian.
- No additional Python runtime packages declared by the project; build and test tools are separate.

Important files:
- `llm_note/store.py`: SQLite and plain-text notebook logic.
- `llm_note/cli.py`: command-line interface.
- `llm_note/gui.py`: loopback web interface and API.
- `llm_note/locales/*.json`: bundled message catalogs.
- `llm_note/templates/denkarium.html`: browser interface.
- `skills/llm-note/SKILL.md`: standalone agent skill.
- `SECURITY.md`: reporting path, maintainer response targets, and implementation boundaries. It does not claim an egress block or fixed remediation deadline.
- `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md` and `THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt`: scoped notes about declared direct dependencies; they are not complete SBOMs or license-compliance certifications.
- `CONTRIBUTING.md`: bilingual contributor guide and local quality checks.
- `MARKETING-LOG.txt`: historical marketing notes with a dated supersession notice.
- `ellmos-module.v2.json`: portable module metadata.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: CI test, lint, and distribution-build workflow.
- `tests/test_metadata.py`: package metadata, navigation, and documentation-integrity checks.

The application does not provide an operating-system network block, sandbox, or privilege drop. Network access depends on the host environment. No zero-egress guarantee is made.

Run local checks:

```bash
python -m pip install -e . pytest build ruff
python -m pytest -ra -v
ruff check llm_note tests
python -m compileall -q llm_note tests
python -m build
```
